mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as investors shift to riskier assets during accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the mean 5-day return in the lowest FEDFUNDS decile is not significantly higher than the highest decile (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-crisis recovery regime (FEDFUNDS at 0-0.25% and GDPC1 growth >2% annually), a CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.2% month-over-month signals inflationary pressures that prompt Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In the post-crisis recovery regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises >0.2%, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) levels indicate robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through improved profit outlooks.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the mean 60-day return in the highest INDPRO decile is not significantly higher than the lowest (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1400 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for durable goods, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns as retail sector concerns spread rapidly.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through heightened recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises >0.3pp and PAYEMS declines >50k, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth >3% annually and UNRATE <4.5%), a deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals economic overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day returns as policy tightening looms.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate (qoq) declines >0.5% from previous quarter
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate declines >0.5%, or the Rank IC between GDPC1 growth and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
